title: Creating a role with no name is blocked with a required-field error
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Create Role page and the Role name field is blank.
custom_steps:
1. Leave the Role name field blank.
  2. Optionally type a description.
  3. Click Create.
  4. Look at the error.
custom_expected:
Creating is blocked.

A 'Role name is a required field' message appears under the 'Role name*' label.
evidence: UI: creating a role with no name is blocked — Create disabled and inline "Role name is a required field" error when the field is touched/cleared.
